revision_reason: Use a schema-valid authorization brief after R02's explanatory metadata was found to be outside the strict work-package schema; no simulation artifact or runtime configuration changes.
objective: Authorize and execute the already reviewed current-main E0 M-Lab multi-OD burst load scan, then select only a provisional load candidate by the preregistered rule and confirm it with additional trace seeds.
context: This is a non-learning load-contract and duplicate-consistency scan, not an algorithm comparison.
The executable matrix is EXP-20260822-E0-LOAD-FORMAL-R02 on current main. R02 supersedes the old R01 authorization/results; R01 and R02 artifacts must never be pooled.

Six cells form three identical control/copy pairs at base offered rates 50, 100 and 200 Mbps. With a 20 s horizon, an 8 s burst starting at 8 s and multiplier 2, integrated averages are 70, 140 and 280 Mbps.
Validity gate: every cell must end naturally, report conservation=true, pass governance and satisfy the acceptance contract; a failure triggers follow-up rather than silent exclusion.

Holding-overflow fraction is HOLDING_QUEUE_OVERFLOW fate count divided by the sum of all packet fate counts; a zero denominator invalidates the cell. Aggregate each pair with the lower delivery_rate and higher overflow fraction; any duplicate fate/primary-metric mismatch invalidates the tier.

Labels are exhaustive after validity: low is delivery_rate >= 0.80 and overflow <= 0.05; medium is delivery_rate >= 0.20 and < 0.80 and overflow <= 0.20; high is every remaining valid tier. Choose the lowest valid medium; if none exists, run a bracket follow-up. A provisional candidate needs at least two additional trace seeds before paper-facing freeze.
Repository M-Lab data is measurement_proxy traffic with reproducible endpoint selection, not calibrated operator traffic or packet capture.
deliverables: A schema-valid independent review/finalization record bound to the exact current-main R02 matrix
Receipt-verified VM outputs for all six cells
A persisted V2 paired analysis and a recomputable provisional load-selection decision
cannot_claim: A universal or final E0 load threshold
Pooling R01 artifacts with R02 artifacts
acceptance: The R02 matrix and this R03 work revision pass independent cold, satellite-DRL and adversarial review.
All six cells complete naturally on one clean deployed SHA with conservation, governance and declared acceptance true.

The provisional load label is recomputed from immutable receipts using the exact validity, denominator, pair aggregation and label rules above; no paper-facing freeze occurs before two additional trace seeds.
